text:
Estimated from the photos, the plate held a rice and chicken/mushroom stir-fry with peppers, about 250 g, at roughly 1.6 kcal/g, which is about 400 kcal. The Drumstick item looks like a small vanilla ice cream cup of about 60 g and 130 kcal. Water adds no energy and is not counted.

The second photo shows the plate nearly empty, with only a sauce residue left, so I assumed about 95% of the stir-fry was eaten. That is about 238 g and 380 kcal. The ice cream cup is empty, so all of it was eaten: 60 g and 130 kcal.

Total eaten is about 298 g and 510 kcal.
